jobs.title: Investment Banking Associate, Healthcare Services and Technology
jobs.description:
Job Title: Investment Banking Associate, Healthcare Services and Technology
Reports to: Head of Investment Banking
Department: I nvestment Banking, Healthcare Services and Technology
Location: New York, NY
Salary Range: $175,000-$200,000

The Investment Banking Associate will be a key member of an experienced team of investment bankers focused on healthcare companies . The successful candidate will provide support to senior bankers in executing M&A and financing transactions for clients across all sub-verticals within Healthcare Services and Technology as well as work with and manage Investment Banking Analysts. This position offers direct CEO, CFO and Board level contact, as well as significant responsibility and opportunity for advancement. Candidates must have previous healthcare investment banking experience at the Associate level.

Primary Duties and Responsibilities:
- Serve an integral team leader in client transactions, projects, or assignments as an Investment Banking Associate.
- Advise with clients and manage internal investment banking team including Analysts & product teams
- Assist in preparation of presentations and marketing materials (e.g. CIM, Management Presentations, etc.) for current and prospective clients
- Prepare valuation analyses and other financial modeling analysis of clients and targets
- Review business plans, conduct research and analyze financial statements
- Review and manage due diligence process, including virtual data room preparation and counterparty Q&A

Experience and Qualifications Required:
- +3 years of investment banking experience with at least 1 year of prior Investment Banking Associate experience, healthcare related transactions preferred
- Strong financial modeling and analytical skills, including knowledge of financial accounting
- Qualified candidates with a BS or BA in finance or similar field of study and a demonstrated exemplary academic record
- Outstanding written and oral communication skills
- Highly motivated, energetic, personable and capable of managing multiple tasks in a dynamic, meritocratic, team-oriented work environment
- Proficient in Microsoft Office

Leerink Partners is a leading investment bank providing a complete suite of financial solutions comprising M&A advisory, equity, debt, and derivative capital markets, equity research, and sales and trading capabilities. The firm’s strategic focus on the healthcare industry empowers it to provide unique advice and insights to its clients. The firm is a broker-dealer registered with the United States Securities and Exchange Commission and a member of the Financial Industry Regulatory Authority.

Equal Employment Opportunity
Leerink Partners is an equal opportunity employer and is dedicated to expanding its commitments and investments to create a more diverse, equitable and inclusive company culture and innovation ecosystem. We are strongly committed to the values and policy of equal employment opportunity across our employment practices.

Actual starting base pay will be determined on skills, experience, and other non-discriminatory factors permitted by law. Total compensation may also include variable incentives, bonuses, benefits, and/or other perks, as outlined in any formal offer made.

jobs.title: Investment Banking Associate/VP, Biopharma Advisory
jobs.description:
Job Title:          Investment Banking Associate / Vice President – M&A
Department:     Investment Banking
Location:         New York
Salary Range:  $175,000 - $250,000

The M&A Sr. Associate or Jr. Vice President will be a key member of an experienced team, contributing to a world-class investment banking practice focused on healthcare and life science companies, with broad and deep contacts within the biopharma and specialty pharmaceuticals industries. The successful candidate will participate in all aspects of originating, structuring and executing sell-side and buy-side M&A transactions.  This position offers the successful candidate consistent execution experience, significant responsibility, and opportunity for advancement. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record in an M&A role on a leading investment banking team.

Primary Duties and Responsibilities:
- Lead the execution and support the origination of M&A transactions including public and private sell-sides, buy-sides, etc.
- Oversee the building and maintenance of complex financial/valuation models, including long range company forecasts, DCF analyses, accretion/dilution analyses and other valuation analyses.
- Develop client relationships through deal execution and pitches as well as communicate and partner with other internal investment banking professionals.
- Work with the Biopharma and Spec Pharma coverage teams on idea generation and material preparation for meetings with clients to discuss potential sell-side or buy-side transactions.

Experience and Qualifications Required:
- Healthcare Investment Banking preferred; Minimum of 4 years in investment banking with significant exposure to M&A.
- Strong technical skills including advanced financial modeling, financial analysis and understanding of valuation concepts.
- Excellent organizational and communication skills including business writing and presentation skills.
- Exemplary academic record: finance and life sciences undergraduate experience preferred but not required, MBA/CFA a plus.
- Highly motivated, energetic, personable, and capable of managing multiple tasks in a dynamic, meritocratic work environment.
- Regulatory qualifications (Series 79, 63,) to work in the financial industry within investment banking; individuals not certified will be required to undertake examinations within 3 months of joining the Firm.

Leerink Partners is a leading investment bank providing a complete suite of financial solutions comprising M&A advisory, equity, debt, and derivative capital markets, equity research, and sales and trading capabilities. jobs.title: Vice President / Senior Associate, ECM
jobs.description:
Job Title: Vice President / Senior Associate, Equity Capital Markets (Healthcare)
Reports to: Co-Head of Investment Banking
Department: Investment Banking
Location: New York
Salary Range: $175,000-$250,000

This is an opportunity to become a leader within a world-class investment banking practice focused on companies in the healthcare industry. The successful candidate will serve as the primary project manager for the Equity Capital Markets (ECM) team, leading the end-to-end execution of a wide array of equity and equity-linked financings, including initial public offerings, follow-ons, structured deals, and convertible debt transactions.

Primary Duties and Responsibilities:
- Lead the end-to-end execution of complex equity transactions, serving as the senior execution lead on the ECM team.
- Act as the central project manager, overseeing day-to-day deal processes and guiding Analysts and Associates to ensure high-quality, timely deliverables.
- Drive new business origination by leading the development of high-impact pitch books and strategic market thematic presentations that leverage firm-wide healthcare expertise.
- Manage senior-level relationships with corporate clients and financial institutions, providing continuous market intelligence, tactical advice, and strategic guidance.
- Work closely with the broader investment banking team to coordinate all aspects of client management and transaction structuring.
- Direct syndicate coordination and manage bookrunning roles to maintain the firm’s competitive positioning as a top-tier healthcare capital markets partner.

Experience and Qualifications Required:
- Four or more years of relevant experience in investment banking, with a significant and proven focus on Equity Capital Markets.
- Deep sector expertise in Healthcare, Biotech, or MedTech, including a nuanced understanding of clinical trial and regulatory (FDA) milestones that drive equity issuance windows.
- BS or BA with an exemplary academic record
- Strong written and oral communication skills, with the demonstrated ability to lead high-stakes client presentations and internal investment committees.
- Demonstrated leadership ability to manage multiple high-pressure workstreams in a dynamic, meritocratic, and team-oriented work environment.
